claim_label: Assisted Performance is not Retained Human Capability.

logical_basis.mechanism: A score taken while the assistant is present measures the coupled person-plus-tool system. Retained capability is a property of the person alone and can only be read after the tool is removed. The two readouts are taken of different systems, so a change in the first does not fix the sign of a change in the second.

premises.text: An assisted score is a readout of the coupled system, not of the person alone.
Unaided post-withdrawal performance can differ in sign from the assisted gain in at least one declared setting.

boundary_conditions: Tasks where the assistant is never withdrawn in practice, so retained unaided capability is not the quantity of interest.
Settings where assisted practice is followed by a structured withdrawal phase designed to transfer the skill.
observable_implication: In a design with an unaided post-withdrawal measurement, assisted gains and unaided gains are recorded as two separate readouts and can diverge.

rival_explanations.rival: Assisted gains are a leading indicator that later appears as unaided gain once practice accumulates.
rival_explanations.distinguishing_observation: A delayed unaided measurement after a longer practice window: the rival predicts the gap closes; P1 makes no such prediction.
